Careers

Join the people behind the mornings

Great schools are made by the staff who show up early, teach well and look after the small moments. If that sounds like you, we’d like to hear from you.

Why work at EIS

A school that asks a lot and gives a lot back

Teach in a community that believes “everybody can learn and succeed”, and invests in the people who make that possible.

  • Classes small enough to actually teach, not herd
  • A calm, well supervised campus and committed parents
  • Real professional development, budgeted term by term
  • Boarding, dining and sports all on the same green campus

Don’t wait for a perfect match. If you can teach or help run a school like EIS, send your CV anyway. We read every one.

Application & CV upload

Send us the best account of yourself

Three things are enough to start: your name, how to reach you, and a short CV. Upload it as a PDF or Word document. Nothing is shared outside the school office.

  • CVs stay confidential; they are read by the school office only
  • Shortlisting is on merit: experience, references and what you wrote
  • You’ll hear back about interviews within two working weeks
  • No role open yet? We keep your CV for the next sensible vacancy

PDF or Word, up to 5 MB. Your application and CV are emailed straight to the school office at principal@eisjalingo.com.

Your application goes to principal@eisjalingo.com, handled confidentially by the school office.

Application received

Thank you. Your CV has been sent to the school office. They will review it and contact you about next steps.

If there is no advert yet, apply anyway
